15: /**
16:  * A class that is capable of comparing files content
17:  */
18: class FileComparator(
19:     private val expectedResultFile: Path,
20:     private val expectedResultList: List<String> = readFile(expectedResultFile),
21:     private val actualResultFile: Path,
22:     private val actualResultList: List<String> = readFile(actualResultFile)
23: ) {
24:     private val diffGenerator = DiffRowGenerator(
25:         columnWidth = Int.MAX_VALUE,
26:         showInlineDiffs = true,
27:         mergeOriginalRevised = false,
28:         inlineDiffByWord = false,
29:         oldTag = { _, start -> if (start) "[" else "]" },
30:         newTag = { _, start -> if (start) "<" else ">" },
31:     )
32: 
33:     constructor(
34:         expectedResultFile: File,
35:         actualResultList: List<String>
36:     ) : this(
37:         expectedResultFile.toPath(),
38:         actualResultFile = Path("No file name.kt"),
39:         actualResultList = actualResultList
40:     )
41: 
42:     constructor(
43:         expectedResultFile: File,
44:         actualResultFile: File
45:     ) : this(
46:         expectedResultFile.toPath(),
47:         actualResultFile = actualResultFile.toPath())
48: 
49:     /**
50:      * @return true in case files are different
51:      * false - in case they are equals
52:      */
53:     @Suppress(
54:         "ReturnCount",
55:         "FUNCTION_BOOLEAN_PREFIX",
56:         "TOO_LONG_FUNCTION"
57:     )
58:     fun compareFilesEqual(): Boolean {
59:         try {
60:             if (expectedResultList.isEmpty()) {
61:                 return false
62:             }
63:             val regex = (".*// ;warn:?(.*):(\\d*): (.+)").toRegex()
64:             val expectWithoutWarn = expectedResultList.filterNot { line ->
65:                 line.contains(regex)
66:             }
67:             val patch = diff(expectWithoutWarn, actualResultList)
68: 
69:             if (patch.deltas.isEmpty()) {
70:                 return true
71:             }
72:             val joinedDeltas = patch.deltas.joinToString(System.lineSeparator()) { delta ->
73:                 when (delta) {
74:                     is ChangeDelta -> diffGenerator
75:                         .generateDiffRows(delta.source.lines, delta.target.lines)
76:                         .joinToString(prefix = "ChangeDelta, position ${delta.source.position}, lines:\n", separator = "\n\n") {
77:                             """-${it.oldLine}
78:                       |+${it.newLine}
79:                       |""".trimMargin()
80:                         }
81:                         .let { "ChangeDelta, position ${delta.source.position}, lines:\n$it" }
82:                     else -> delta.toString()
83:                 }
84:             }
85: 
86:             log.error("""
87:                 |Expected result from <${expectedResultFile.name}> and <${actualResultFile.name}> formatted are different.
88:                 |See difference below:
89:                 |$joinedDeltas
90:                 """.trimMargin()
91:             )
92:         } catch (e: RuntimeException) {
93:             log.error("Not able to prepare diffs between <${expectedResultFile.name}> and <${actualResultFile.name}>", e)
94:         }
95:         return false
96:     }
97: 
98:     companion object {
99:         private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FileComparator::class.java)
100: 
101:         /**
102:          * @param file file where to write these list to, separated with newlines.
103:          * @return a list of lines from the file, or an empty list if an I/O error
104:          *   has occurred.
105:          */
106:         private fun readFile(file: Path): List<String> =
107:             try {
108:                 file.readLines()
109:             } catch (e: IOException) {
110:                 log.error("Not able to read file: $file")
111:                 emptyList()
112:             }
113:     }
114: }

43:         testFileStr: String,
44:         trimLastEmptyLine: Boolean = false
45:     ): FileComparisonResult {
46:         val expectedPath = javaClass.classLoader.getResource("$resourceFilePath/$expectedResult")
47:         val testPath = javaClass.classLoader.getResource("$resourceFilePath/$testFileStr")
48:         if (testPath == null || expectedPath == null) {

50:             return FileComparisonResult(

53:                 expectedContent = "// $resourceFilePath/$testFileStr is found: ${expectedPath != null}")

67:      *   the file should end with **two** consecutive linebreaks.
